centre.en: Data centres in the United States now use more than 4% of the country's entire electricity supply.
centre.zh: 美国的数据中心目前消耗了该国全社会用电量的4%以上。

centre.en: And yes, this episode and my voice today are brought to you courtesy of your local data centre.
centre.zh: 是的，今天的这期节目和我的声音，正是由你当地的数据中心为你呈现的。

century.en: Something more complicated, though, started to happen from the 17th century onwards.
century.zh: 然而，从17世纪开始，更复杂的事情开始发生。

century.en: For centuries, many rural communities had access to common land, right?
century.zh: 几个世纪以来，许多农村社区都可以使用公共土地，对吧？
